description:
Verification events (confirmed, changed, source gone, blocked, disputed) since a date for places within a radius of a town, county or point, newest first. The way to answer "has anything changed around Tahoe since my last trip?" or to re-check a saved itinerary. Use dogpolicies_changes_since for everything everywhere.

Example: "What changed near Monterey since September?" -> place="Monterey", since="2026-09-01"

near.description: A point instead of a town; give one of place or near

place.description: A city, county or area in California or Nevada, e.g. "Monterey", "South Lake Tahoe", "Washoe County, NV", "Las Vegas", "East Bay" or "Lake Tahoe"

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around the town or point (an area is its own boundary; the radius is ignored)

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: dogpolicies_changes_near
title: What changed near a town
